notes.title: Whirlight - No Time To Trip Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey adventurers!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/][b]Whirlight - No Time to Trip's Demo is now live![/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/93f18d8f5439d97203ec80f5b2dd0c009b017277.jpg[/img]

Step into the shoes of Hector, our quirky middle-aged scientist whose luck is as peculiar as his inventions. Alongside Margaret, a strong and determined artist, you'll explore the charming Verice Bay, journey through time, and meet an array of bizarre characters.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/]Whirlight - No Time to Trip[/url] is a point-and-click adventure that captures the spirit of classic games like "Day of the Tentacle" and "Sam & Max Hit the Road," with its whimsical humor, hand-drawn graphics, and engaging story. From the acclaimed developers of "[b]Willy Morgan and the Curse of Bone Town[/b]," this game promises a unique and unforgettable experience.

What's in the demo?

[list]
[*] [b]Dive into the early chapters[/b] of Hector and Margaret's adventure.
[*] Experience the vibrant, cartoony atmosphere and witty dialogue.
[*] Get a taste of the time-traveling mechanics and puzzle-solving fun.
[*] 
[/list]

🚀 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/]Play the demo now[/url] and join Hector's extraordinary journey!

🌟 We're also excited to announce our participation in the [b]Adventure Game Fan Fair on July 26-28[/b]. While we won't be attending in person, we'll be connecting with players on-site, sharing insights, and answering your burning questions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/4eff5f6a43620b03d091a3b71ad7b6f6d1b7408e.jpg[/img]

🔔 Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/][b]wishlist Whirlight: No Time to Trip[/b][/url] to stay updated on the latest news and developments. Your support helps us bring this adventure to life!

🎉 Join our community! Be part of the conversation and share your experiences with fellow adventurers on our Discord server [[url=https://discord.gg/F3HGZz2aCe]Join Here[/url]]. Your feedback is invaluable to us!

Thank you for being a part of this whimsical journey. We can't wait to hear about your adventures in Verice Bay!

If you like our demo, please consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/]supporting us with a wishlist[/url]! Happy adventuring!

[url=https://discord.gg/F3HGZz2aCe]Join our Discord server[/url] and be part of the community!

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is now available!
notes.content:
Bone Town adventurers beware, we released Willy Morgan [b]patch 1.2 [/b] today which introduces the following new features:

[list]
[*] Added the D-pad functionality in the main menu, in the game menu and in the choice of answers for the gamepad.
[*] Introduced localization in Brazilian Portuguese and Traditional Chinese.
[/list]
[b]Note[/b]: with the v.1.2 update, partial controller support and related functions are active only if the Xbox configurator and the like is disabled. If the Xbox configurator is active you will not be able to use your gamepad correctly in game.

To disable the Xbox configurator, go to Steam> Settings> Controllers> General Settings and remove the relevant tick. With the v.1.2 update the developer recommended configuration for the Gamepad is no longer available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/629eeb831c9416429847c73520e5870a23ef7727.png[/img]

We will resolve this issue as soon as possible, thanks.

notes.title: Willy Morgan - Patch 1.1 is now available!
notes.content:
As we previously announced, we have some news related to Willy Morgan. Patch 1.1 is now available, introducing the following new features:

[list]
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[*] Corrections on translations/dubbing
[*] Added autosave functionality
[*] Added the "Text background" functionality in the "Options" menu
[*] Added partial controller support
[*] Credits added to the game's main menu
[/list]

Thanks for the support. Stay tuned for other news!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
we are working hard to make the game even better [b]thanks to your feedback [/b]

We are working on the first patch that will include:

- Adding controller support
- Minor bug fixes (eg bike memo) and translation / dubbing fixes
- Adding "Text background" option 
- Credits in the title screen

we are also working to add more language support/localization and do some  HUGE announcements next months :-)

notes.title: Thank you everyone for the reviews!
notes.content:
We'd like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who supported us and played our game! 
[b]We have an amazing community![/b]

If you liked Willy Morgan, please leave a positive review. That would be really helpful <3

[h2]#MakePointandlickGreatAgain[/h2]

And a special thanks to all the video game web sites, blogs and curators that reviewed Willy Morgan with such passion and deep interest! Here's a quick overview:


[i]"ImaginaryLab did a good job taking inspirations from the Monkey Island games whilst keeping Willy Morgan an original and fresh experience."[/i] - [url=https://www.gamingrespawn.com/amp/reviews/50333/willy-morgan-and-the-curse-of-bone-town-review/?fbclid=IwAR2dn_ONkzV2zia1AmNWIQ7krDSCscBsux2YK0NH1c2TxwDUzvzoxU_ijqE]Gaming Respawn[/url]
[h2]9/10[/h2]

[i]"Fans of the genre will surely feel satisfied with this enjoyable pirate adventure"[/i] - [url=https://gamesurf.tiscali.it/recensioni/articoli/Recensione-Willy-Morgan-and-the-Curse-of-Bone-Town/?fbclid=IwAR0lPGMpvLffEHa6NDwPWY9peHozCp633PiZulj3ZcyA2XAWjtYgWqfLquM]GameSurf[/url] 
[h2]8/10[/h2]

[i]"A very solid and joyful addition to the adventure game genre"[/i] - [url=https://thegamingoutsider.com/2020/08/12/willy-morgan-and-the-curse-of-bone-town-pc-review/tbecks/?fbclid=IwAR2wE2baTescACPz0s3lSXPW8cBlG9GscqDoOLEDV3JfXy1adyRtoq2t-dw]The Gaming Outsider[/url]
[h2]8/10[/h2]

[i]"A wonderful throwback of a game that will appeal to those looking for a piece of their past as a nostalgic trip, as well as those breaking into the point and click adventure scene."[/i] - [url=http://chalgyr.com/2020/08/review-pc-willymorgan-curseofbonetown.html?fbclid=IwAR2yFsOqWTO1sNLueBZkmu9aNv7xVhlDJqdCWGGS-S6wlpb4qOnBgY5p6kQ]Chalgyr[/url]
[h2]8/10[/h2]

[i]"With a simple but interesting plot, well-characterized characters and convincing and ironic dialogues, we can't but consider the Imaginarylab title a well-crafted one and advisable both for veterans of the genre and for newbies."[/i] - [url=https://www.gamesource.it/recensioni/willy-morgan-and-the-curse-of-bone-town-recensione/?fbclid=IwAR3ARdtNknPvNYsnPKT41KotNHMRU-NRaoKsM3gGuPSjtQNveznunZTTgF8]Gamesource[/url] 
[h2]7.5/10[/h2]

[i]"My love of point and click games has been rekindled thanks to Willy Morgan" [/i]- [url=https://www.thumbculture.co.uk/willy-morgan-pc-review-hey-you-guysssssssss?fbclid=IwAR1RWlbyYK0V9P-UgwnVLuC53GkL74zSP2ZYv5zYSBTBWgDecRvizPnhMqs]Thumb Culture[/url]

notes.title: STEAM GAME FESTIVAL IS HERE!
notes.content:
Join us at the Steam Summer Game Festival as we're playing through Willy Morgan and answering your questions live on our Steam chat and [url=https://discord.gg/e4vpkGE]Discord[/url]!

[previewyoutube=Xxcb3BT20xQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About the game[/h2]
Willy Morgan is a pirate-themed point and click game, ispired by timeless classics like Monkey Island. Explore a modern pirate town, collect clues, solve puzzles and investigate the mysterious disappearance of Willy's father. 

[h2]About the DEMO[/h2]
This is the prologue of our story, about 30 mins of gameplay that will take you straight into Willy's world. Help him find all he needs around his house and join him in his incredible adventure!  

[h2]Additional info[/h2]
Willy Morgan is developed by [b]imaginarylab[/b], a small indie studio made of point-and-click and old adventure games aficionados, set up with the goal of telling unforgettable stories. 
The game is published by [b]VLG[/b], a publishing service company working with games that tell strong stories and cast an eye on culture, while bringing truly memorable entertainment to gamers across the spectrum, whether on PC, console or mobile, and wherever in the world they may be playing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1097110/Willy_Morgan_and_the_Curse_of_Bone_Town/

notes.title: Welcome adventurers!
notes.content:
It is with great pleasure that we present to you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35531092/3b6867e18abb839267d9095ed2cbecf51229bb48.png[/img]

An upcoming [b]story-driven point-and-click adventure[/b] packed with irony and puzzles, featuring a dreamy atmosphere and a very unique deformed graphic style. Embark on a journey to explore a [b]modern pirate town[/b], collect clues and [b]investigate[/b] the disappearance of Willy’s father. But remember: you can’t trust anyone...

Will you be able to cut through lies and put the pieces together?
